probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Halden® Pricing Changelog Help Blog About Overview Buy Halden App Store Google Play © 2026 Halden® Focus Start a focus session Give today's thing a timed block of attention and keep your phone out of the way. A focus session is a timed block for today’s thing and nothing else. Halden counts down, keeps the session on your lock screen and logs the time against the day, so your record shows not only what got done but how much attention it took. Start a session On Today, tap your thing and choose Focus . Pick a length. The free plan offers 25 minutes; Pro lets you choose anything from 10 to 90. Put the phone face down. The timer keeps running on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island. When the time is up, Halden plays one soft sound and asks whether the thing is done. Tap Done to mark the day, or Not yet to keep going later. Pause, stop or extend Tap the timer on the lock screen to pause. A paused session waits for up to an hour before it ends on its own. To stop early, open Halden and tap End session : the minutes you spent still count. To add time, tap Plus 10 before the timer reaches zero.
